item.title: Cantonment Garage Destroyed By Fire
item.description: Fire destroyed a garage Saturday afternoon in Cantonment. The fire in the 3500 block of Wiggins Lane was reported around 4:45 p.m. Firefighters arrived to find the structure engulfed in flames. David Uebelsteadt, a local race car driver and mechanic, said the entire shop was a total loss. A wooden boat was also destroyed. There were no injuries [...]
